label: Some act done at every accessible world strictly yields an effect that is contingent
paraphrase: Constraint candidate (#462, #555), analyst formulation: in some frame an act token is performed at every world accessible from w, is strictly efficacious for an effect x (x exists wherever the token is performed at an accessible world), and x is contingent at w (exists at w and is absent at some accessible world). A defender of a necessary, simple root and contingent creation who reads the root's act as strictly efficacious needs it; the first clause of STMT-SIMPLICITY-COLLAPSE-CORE is its exact negation.
